description: This file defines the SearchQuery class, a Drupal module component that extends database query capabilities to perform full-text search operations on the search index. It includes methods for parsing search expressions, preparing and normalizing search queries, adding scoring mechanisms, executing searches, and counting results.

classes.name: SearchQuery
classes.description: A class extending Drupal's database query to facilitate full-text search operations, including parsing search expressions, scoring, normalization, and execution of search queries on the search index.

methods.name: searchExpression
methods.description: Sets the search expression string and search type, initializes query conditions and status.

methods.name: parseSearchExpression
methods.description: Parses the user-entered search string into SQL conditions, handling positive/negative keywords, phrases, and logical operators.

methods.name: parseWord
methods.description: Splits a phrase into individual words, adds new words to the search keywords list, and returns counts.

methods.name: prepareAndNormalize
methods.description: Prepares the search query, calculates normalization factors, and determines if the query has matching keywords.

methods.name: preExecute
methods.description: Prepares the query before execution, ensuring normalization is done.

methods.name: addScore
methods.description: Adds a custom scoring expression to influence search result ranking.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the constructed search query, applying conditions, scores, and ordering.

methods.name: countQuery
methods.description: Builds a count query for the search results, considering the same conditions.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns a bitmap indicating the current status of the search query, including errors or warnings.
